description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book Saltwater Serenity:* 4 Fun Pug Bikes * Golf Cart Included ($250 Refundable Deposit Required)* Wrap Around Porch with Porch Swing * Community Pool (seasonally heated)* Close to Seaside, WaterColor and Rosemary Beach* Professionally ManagedThis property is NOT available to guests under 25. No exceptions.We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates Available.Snowbird Season runs November–February. Monthly rentals require arrival on the 1st and departure on the 1st of a following month. All monthly stays include an additional $150 cleaning fee. Contact us for custom date requests!Welcome to Saltwater Serenity!This 4 bedroom/3.5 bath coastal home offers over 2,400 square feet of upscale living space in the gated community of Greenway Park, perfectly situated on 30A within blocks of local favorites like Perfect Pig, Beachy Bean Coffee, and Old Florida Fish House, and just steps from the 18.6-mile paved bike trail connecting to Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, Watercolor, Seaside, Seagrove, and Rosemary Beach. The corner-lot property features a large wraparound porch with oversized rocking chairs and an outdoor sofa, ideal for gathering after a day at the beach. Inside, an open first-floor layout combines an elegantly designed living room with a stunning gourmet kitchen, stainless-steel appliances, quartz countertops, and a large island seating five. The first floor also includes one of two master suites, with a king bed, en-suite marble-tiled walk-in shower, and double-vanity bath, plus a full laundry room and a fully equipped coffee bar with a Nespresso espresso machine. Upstairs, guests will find a den with a theater-style smart TV, a queen bedroom, a fun bunk room with a trundle, and a second luxurious king master suite featuring a spa-like bath with an oval garden tub and marble-tiled glass shower. With smart TVs throughout, high-speed internet, and thoughtfully stocked kitchen essentials, this home is a true paradise for families and groups seeking comfort, space, and easy access to everything 30A has to offer.The Bed Setup:1st Floor:1st Master Bedroom: King BedLiving room: Sleeper Sofa2nd Floor:2nd Master Bedroom: King Bed Guest Bedroom 1: Queen BedGuest Bedroom 2: Twin over Full + TrundleArea Attractions:Greenway Station is 30A's newest destination for gathering, shopping, and dining in Seagrove Beach. Greenway Station features known retailers Wild Olives Tapas and Wine Bar, Pecan Jack's Ice Cream, Coast Hippie, and YOLO Board + Bike, plus introduces Local Cantina Mexican Restaurant, Souper Jenny Coffee Roasters, Canopy Road Café, and more.Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in The Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It's incredible architecture has helped to make it famous, but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater, and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous.30A is a fantastic destination; the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar-white sand and emerald-green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. There are activities for everyone: kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
